smoke.start: On Mikrus run the isolated test suite on demand from a private temporary archive of origin/smoke, with synthetic state and networking disabled. Use the controller profile runbook; no persistent smoke service.
smoke.verify: Record the full archived commit and test result from the same isolated run. In the absence of a run use stopped only when verified; fixture results do not attest a serving controller.

main.start: The operator activates a reviewed immutable main release for agent-github-flow-mvp.service on Mikrus. GitHub promotion changes the branch; service activation is a separate operation.
main.verify: Check the running service PID and start time, resolve its current release and verify the full revision against origin/main as described in docs/controller-deployment-profile.md. Check operational alerts separately.
